summary: Test-only timeout acknowledgement contracts are substantive and consistent with unchanged production. Candidate03 closes the pre-operation snapshot gap; original8 scenarios/23 checks remain exact, final21 scenarios/118 checks pass in supplied native evidence. checks.result: Removing only acknowledgement additions and reversing guarded route/query/report edits reconstructs base test exactly after LF normalization. Four original named functions and all original case names/order/check names/results match. Original cases never enter the three delegating observers; added service sorting is acknowledgement-only. No original path/oracle removed.

Actual multipart bodies are parsed at the synthetic Drive HTTP boundary. Twelve timeout cases issue POST,PATCH,PATCH with literal intended sanitized bytes; replies stay held while server state is committed. Real30000ms timers and500/1000ms backoffs are advanced by native browser clock. Final SAVE_FILE_TIMEOUT precedes actual canonical readback; no injected timeout exception or replacement uploader/timeout/fingerprint/validator.

Four filenames have independent literal matching/different decisions: settings target count, deletion identity, portfolio writing, index file ID. Matching settings changes key order and updatedAt; deletions ignores updatedAt; portfolio ignores __syncMeta. Existing server-ordered lookup/first-result canonical policy and real cached metadata validation are used, with older decoy retained. Real download parses settings/deletions/portfolio required shapes; index uses requiredShape=false and full-data equality, without inventing index-schema validation.

Observers invoke real methods and propagate identical data/errors. Mismatch and missing canonical return the identical terminal save error; actual HTTP403 returns that original non-timeout error with no recovery request/readback/cache publication. Invalid settings/deletions produce actual required-storage Error; invalid portfolio produces TypeError, no parsed success/returned ID. Native events show legitimate cache writes before timeout/readback, only matching cases add a post-parse recovery write. Missing canonical clears the real lower-level invalid cache.

Candidate03 initialization seeds a nonempty DOM draft and observers, then captures before calling uploader. All13 new cases preserve exact draft newline/trailing spaces, four durable storage bytes, pending values/persisted bytes, three dirty flags, six local/synced counters and caller payload. Settings multipart excludes apiKey while caller retains it. After403, healthy real retry uploads sanitized literal data, returns/persists accepted-1 and preserves the same state projection. Candidate01/02 retention evidence is explicitly superseded.

Every check row contributes to case and final aggregate; expected21 cases are enforced, rejected operations propagate to outer nonzero exit, and report is saved in finally. Existing runner WFT_TEST_REPORT alias reads nonempty case pass flags and child status. Held routes are aborted only after operation result and snapshots; abort catch is teardown, not an oracle bypass. Final report/log agree on all scenario/check outcomes.
